name: Asistent detektiva Zbyška
source: Detective Zbyšek Claus is a brave dolphin who protects cute city Regenbogen from crime. You are the best student of the detective school and Zbyšek himself will teach you how to be a good detective. In the day of your admission is a young unicorn murdered. Show your best in the investigation of this difficult case. Team of great forensics detectives is going to help you. But be careful. Evil is hidden in unexpected places.
translation:
侦探兹比谢克·克劳斯是一只勇敢的海豚，一直保护着可爱的雷根博根市，使其免受犯罪侵扰。你是侦探学校的最优秀学生，兹比谢克本人将教你如何成为一名好侦探。

就在你入学当天，一只年轻独角兽遭到谋杀。请在这起疑难案件的调查中拿出最佳表现。一支优秀的法医侦探团队将会协助你，但千万小心：邪恶往往藏在意想不到的地方。
